title: Little Haunts Club: Cozy Spooky Moments — 15 Printable Coloring Pages
purpose: First seasonal Etsy validation product: original cute-spooky, kid-friendly and adult-friendly everyday moments with clear humor, readable physical logic, and bold open coloring areas. A curated 15-page first release, not a generic high-page-count bundle.
audience: older children, teens, and adults who enjoy cute, cozy Halloween art
format: Printable US Letter and A4 PDFs plus individual high-resolution PNG pages
visual_bible: Original cute-spooky storybook coloring page, clean solid-black contours on pure white paper, blank white interiors ready for coloring, bold smooth outer contours with only a few purposeful inner lines, rounded friendly proportions, expressive but simple ghost and cat faces, broad surfaces, medium-large colorable regions, clear gaps between objects, and a calm readable composition. One central gag or activity, one obvious focal character, and three to five useful supporting objects. Every prop has an obvious physical relationship: feet touch floors, furniture rests on the floor, books rest on shelves or tables, shelves attach to walls or stand on supports, handles connect to the objects they belong to, and doors and windows fit inside their frames. The only airborne characters are intentionally floating ghosts and tiny bats; all inanimate props are supported by a surface or visibly attached. Keep the humor in the situation and expressions, the scene friendly rather than frightening, and the background simple. Use crisp, printable black line art with white interiors throughout; express volume through silhouette and overlap rather than tonal rendering.

listing.description: Meet the Little Haunts Club: a friendly sheet ghost and curious black cat getting into silly, cozy Halloween situations. This original collection includes costume repairs, laundry day, pumpkin soup, blanket-fort adventures, silly costume try-ons, midnight tea, candy sorting, and other playful spooky moments. The designs use crisp black outlines and open white areas for your own colors.
listing.price_test: Launch at $2.99 for the initial seasonal validation test. If listing views, favorites, and conversion are healthy, test $3.49; expand the pack or create a companion product before raising the price substantially.
